messages.text:
Hi! My name is Juliet, I have just arrived to Gold Coast. I’m from Argentina, I am looking for a furnished room near the beach, to have a quiet life in touch with nature. I’m an online psychologist, I have my sessions in the morning, after going for a run (I love sports!). I am also a photographer and videographer. I am tidy, quiet and respectful of others; I am a social person buy also love my alone time to recharge energy. 
I hope I could visit your place to see if we can make it work! Thank you so much ❤️
Hey! I was wondering if you saw my message, we are actually a few friends wanting to move together:)
